validation_report.aggregation_rule: per joint: breaks if any run in the joint's scope breaks, else inconclusive if any is inconclusive, else holds. J5's scope is the plan's (ICINV curves and FIB C16-1 targets: RUN-SEMAEV-9cab7b, -3e69b6); J6's scope is RUN-SEMAEV-0e5876 only, so J6 carries no verdict on the other six runs.

failed_or_inconclusive_findings.finding: manifest.yaml run.code.commit records the HEAD at manifest-write time, a commit made during the trial by the supervising session (the previous trial's record commit, or for RUN-SEMAEV-9cab7b the round-1 review-plan commit), not the launch commit that environment.json and execution-receipt.json authority record. Pinned sources are byte-identical at both commits; no recorded value depends on the field. Scored breaks because the plan's breaking artifact is an inconsistent receipt field across manifest, environment and receipt.

no uncensored S4-derived arm output exists to compare in fib-005, mtic-007, mtic-008 and mtic-010b (all solves capped), and fib-decision does not call S4; the plan's J5 scope (ICINV, FIB C16-1) holds.

in these runs some or all legacy-vs-repaired equalities on S4-dependent outputs are equalities of capped (censored) values. They cannot show that the two S4 polynomials agree, and J5 shows they differ on every curve tested (227 vs 439 terms generically). Conclusion fields that are monotone in the censored value (resource_exhaustion, all-capped, K* infinite / regime (i) from a T_desc lower bound) are unaffected.

observations: O1: F2/F3/F5 (RUN-SEMAEV-0e5876, under J1 holds): a colliding 2026-10-30 record under the same run id exists in reachable history (c054500cff, infrastructure_error) though HEAD keeps the original; the immutability tool flags the sanctioned store move; the manifest command names the parent launcher by design.
O2: RUN-SEMAEV-0e5876 ran 2026-10-19T01:57-02:22Z and was committed 2026-10-24T19:18Z; no protected path changed in between.

O3: the FIB arms replace driver.decompcost._worker with fib_child.solve in BOTH arms; each capped spawn child also hashes and loads its arm module inside the 20 s window. This is not an arm difference, but it adds a small constant to every child's wall time relative to the archive (A/A timing only).

O4: median_cost_seconds is the upper median (sorted[n//2]), the archived pipeline's convention (the archived RUN-FIB-007/008 ratio 8.618669826845604e-06 reproduces exactly with it); the mean-of-middle-two median differs by <0.1% (C16-1 archive 0.0279397 vs 0.0279151 s).

O5: timing-derived fields rest on one execution per arm. fib-decision C16-1 Spearman rho_s (recomputed exactly): archived -0.0236, legacy -0.0969, repaired -0.3656 (permutation p < 0.001 in both the record and the validator's 2000-draw test), against the |rho_s| >= 0.4 gate; the archived-vs-legacy A/A difference of 0.073 is timing alone. Predictor-cost ratio C16-1: 8.62e-6 archived, 4.16e-6 legacy, 6.5e-8 repaired; every ratio is <= 0.1 so the cost gate is unchanged.

O6: fib-004 repaired arm measured 31 C16-2 targets (stop per_run_wall_cap_1800s) against 75 in legacy and archive, because repaired C16-1 solves took a 3.68 s median against 0.058 s; C16-2 conclusion fields are unchanged.

O7: mtic-010b ablation T_desc counts and medians exist in the arm outputs only as run_mtic's per-base summary (no per-target rows); K* and regime were recomputed from the recorded accountings at that granularity.

O8: the successor specification's invalidation rule is copied from the parent ('Any archived artifact or experiment directory other than experiments/EXP-SEMAEV-93d5cc/ is written'); read literally it is violated by the successor writing its own directory. The handoff write_scope (experiments/EXP-SEMAEV-6e9dcf/runs) governs and was respected.
O9: specification.yaml of both experiments changed after launch only in status (approved -> analyzed); environment.json binds the launch-commit version.
limitations: J5 used the FIB-001 instance builder (driver/instances.py, which imports harness.toycurve only) to regenerate C16-1's factor base and targets; the regenerated instance's fingerprint equals frozen-instances.yaml's sha256.
Groebner bases were computed with Singular 4.4.1 (the producer used sympy); reduced bases are unique, so sizes and degrees are comparable.
Permutation p-values were recomputed with an independent RNG (2000 draws); only gate outcomes are compared, not exact p.

Fields not recomputed: fib-decision CTRL-LABEL-SHUFFLE_pass, per_curve_correlation p and null-band values, the rule string; mtic ideal_enumeration_disagreements and n_targets are read from the arm raw metrics.
